title: 7th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/2/2025).

Question time: Hithadhoo Central MP Ahmed Azaan asks Minister of Health Abdulla Nazim Ibrahim, for a written answer, why the catheterisation laboratory (cath lab) set up at Addu Equatorial Hospital has not yet started providing services, and on what date the public will be able to use it.
Preliminary debate on the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Ihavandhoo MP Ahmed Naseer to amend Law No. 4/2012 (Thalassaemia Control Act).

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal to gauge members' views on the rules for paying education-sector and health-sector workers for overtime work and on establishing a fair working environment.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took a written question about the unopened cath lab at Addu Equatorial Hospital, began the preliminary debate on the Thalassaemia Control Act amendment and continued the overtime-pay resolution debate.
